narrative: He lives in Missouri and has been playing fantasy sports for a long time. Played in the league for 4 seasons from 2006 until 2009. Competitive owner with a 40-37 record but only made the Playoffs once and lost in the 1st round. He had a Defensive Player of the Year award in 2007 with Patrick Willis. And holds a record of the Lowest score ever in a game. With the way our scoring has changed, it will probably never be broken. Solid owner and was part of a 3 person committee for rules. He left the league to spend more time with his daughter and her sports activities.
